paper_record.title: From Chemical Complexity to Tunable Magnetic Ordering in Highly Disordered High-Entropy Spinel Oxides
paper_record.abstract: High-entropy stabilization chemistry is redefining materials design by transforming configurational disorder, arising from the deliberate incorporation of multiple principal cations, into a thermodynamic advantage that promotes phase stability and enables emergent functionalities. In this work, we investigate the evolution of magnetic ordering in spinel-type high entropy oxides by systematically varying the cation composition of the B site within a fixed high-entropy A-site matrix, (Ni$_{0.2}$Mg$_{0.2}$Co$_{0.2}$Cu$_{0.2}$Zn$_{0.2}$)B$_2$O$_4$. Upon introducing multicomponent B-site configurations, we uncover a strikingly linear dependence of the magnetic transition temperature (T$_C$) on the T$_C$s of the corresponding single B-site high-entropy systems. Remarkably, this trend persists even in highly complex (Ni$_{0.2}$Mg$_{0.2}$Co$_{0.2}$Cu$_{0.2}$Zn$_{0.2}$)(Cr$_{0.2}$Mn$_{0.2}$Fe$_{0.2}$Ga$_{0.2}$X$_{0.2}$)$_2$O$_4$, X = Al and Ti. Despite the material's extremely high degree of disorder, absence of a dominant magnetic ion or a straightforward superexchange pathway, detailed magnetization measurements, low-temperature X-ray magnetic circular dichroism, and neutron powder diffraction studies reveal robust long-range ferrimagnetic ordering. These results reveal an emergent predictability in ferrimagnetic high-entropy spinel oxides, where, despite extreme configurational disorder and competing interactions, robust ferrimagnetic order can arise from, rather than be hindered by, extreme configurational disorder. This establishes a pathway for predictively tuning magnetic transition temperatures in high-entropy oxides beyond conventional ordered systems.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 研究发现高熵尖晶石氧化物中存在一种涌现的磁性可预测性，其磁转变温度随组分呈线性算术平均规律变化。
one_sentence_summary.en: The study reveals emergent predictability in high-entropy spinel oxides, where magnetic transition temperatures follow a linear arithmetic average of constituent parent systems despite extreme disorder.

problem.zh: 在高熵氧化物中，极端的构型无序通常被认为会破坏长程磁有序，如何系统地预测和调控这种复杂体系的磁转变温度是一个挑战。
problem.en: Extreme configurational disorder in high-entropy oxides is typically thought to disrupt long-range magnetic order, making the systematic prediction and tuning of magnetic transition temperatures a significant challenge.

approach.zh: 通过固定高熵 A 位基体，系统改变 B 位阳离子组分，结合 XRD、STEM、XAS/XMCD 和中子粉末衍射等手段，分析其磁性演化规律。
approach.en: Systematically varying B-site cation compositions within a fixed high-entropy A-site matrix, and employing a combination of XRD, STEM, XAS/XMCD, and neutron powder diffraction to analyze magnetic evolution.

main_takeaway.zh: 高熵尖晶石氧化物的磁转变温度遵循各组分母体系统的算术平均值，证明了无序体系中存在涌现的统计平均交换相互作用。
main_takeaway.en: Magnetic transition temperatures in high-entropy spinel oxides follow an arithmetic average of the parent systems, demonstrating that emergent statistical averaging of exchange interactions governs the magnetic ground state.

why_it_matters.zh: 该发现为通过成分工程理性设计高熵磁性材料提供了新范式，表明无序本身可以成为组织集体磁行为的原则。
why_it_matters.en: This discovery provides a new paradigm for rationally designing high-entropy magnetic materials via compositional engineering, showing that disorder itself can serve as an organizing principle for collective magnetic behavior.

reason.zh: 揭示了极端无序体系中磁性行为的简单线性规律，为高熵材料的磁性设计提供了明确的理论指导。
reason.en: It reveals a simple linear scaling law for magnetic behavior in extremely disordered systems, providing clear theoretical guidance for the design of high-entropy magnetic materials.

reason.zh: 该研究结合了多种先进表征手段，且提出了高熵材料领域具有普适性的设计规律，符合该期刊的定位。
reason.en: The study combines multiple advanced characterization techniques and proposes a universal design rule for high-entropy materials, fitting the scope of the journal.
